node.statement: If M were not R-orientable, GT-hatcher-AT-thm-3.26(b) would give an injective map H_d(M;R) -> H_d(M||x;R) ≅ R whose image is {r in R : 2r=0}. Since R is the real field, this image is {0}; injectivity would force H_d(M;R)=0, contradicting node 1.1.2.2. Therefore M is R-orientable.
